_comment: Credential-free description of the broker topology this stack expects.
This file is the auditable reference for what entrypoint.sh creates at
runtime. It is intentionally NOT imported with `rabbitmqctl
import_definitions`: a definitions file must embed a password hash for
every user (the `users`/`password_hash` pair, i.e. an equivalent of the
credential itself), and committing that would put a secret in version
control. A tracked file that is never imported cannot leak one, and the
audit forbids storing sensitive data outside .env.
Credentials come from RABBITMQ_USER / RABBITMQ_PASSWORD in the environment
(compose `.env`) and are applied by entrypoint.sh, which verifies them with
sentinel that the healthcheck in docker-compose.yml waits for.
REPLACE_ME_* values below are placeholders, not secrets.
rabbit_version is the major/minor of the broker this topology was written
against. This image is alpine:3.23 + `apk add rabbitmq-server`, whose version
tracks the Alpine 3.23 community package (RabbitMQ 4.2.7-r0), so the field
matches the reference stack even though the base image differs.
